services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Are you ready to get evil? Over the course of the week we will be exploring popular villains from musicals, TV, and movies! Villains like Scar, Miss Hannigan, Captain Hook, Miss Trunchbull, Ursula and many more! At the end of the week we will do a presentation for close family and friends. What a wicked way to start out the summer! A Northern Stage Favorite returns this summer, Lions, Tigers and Bears! Oh My! The students will get to explore different beloved animal characters from musicals, TV, and movies. Characters like Simba, Tigger, The Cowardly lion and many more! At the end of the week we will do a presentation for close family and friends. It will be a wildly good time. To learn
